executive_summary:
This episode introduces a new tipster — "Harry Meyers," a former U.S. military sensor operator — whose account, presented as read-aloud documentary evidence, connects three threads: (1) a 1990 Joint Task Force 6 / Operation Catacomb discovery of a Sinaloa cartel rail tunnel at the Arizona–Mexico border, with photos allegedly implicating a JTF-6 commander with El Chapo; (2) Harry's September 8–9, 2025 visit to Fort Huachuca, during which he reportedly walked into a high-level Joint Task Force Southern Border (JTF-SB) meeting, observed ~12–13 lieutenant colonels, identified Brian Harpole exiting the meeting, and was detained for a 7-hour interrogation by a "Captain Nef" that generated incident report 861-1-2025-MPC446; and (3) an alleged surveillance/intelligence presence in Nashville, where seven tipsters claim Arcadi Gaydamak (recently sentenced in absentia) is operating as "Jonathan Schmidt" at Root Brands.

The episode also plays a 1990 news clip about the Douglas, Arizona tunnel bust, a George H.W. Bush war-on-drugs clip, and a Tim Pool audio segment criticizing Candace Owens. The central structural importance is that it converts an unverified tip (with documents and an incident report number) into a formally inscribed investigative record requiring FOIA verification of the Fort Huachuca incident report.

nodes.name: Harry Meyers
nodes.description: Former U.S. Army sensor operator assigned to Joint Task Force 6 / Operation Catacomb in 1990 who claims to have discovered the first Sinaloa cartel underground rail tunnel at the Arizona–Mexico border. Placed under NDA 1990–May 2025. Now operates under a different name. Per his account, walked into a JTF-SB meeting at Fort Huachuca on September 9, 2025 and was detained for 7 hours.

nodes.name: Brian Harpole
nodes.description: Allegedly identified by Harry Meyers exiting the JTF-SB meeting at Fort Huachuca on September 9, 2025. Host later references this identification in connection with Charlie Kirk's assassination coverage.

nodes.name: Captain Adam Nef
nodes.description: Military officer (Captain) identified by Harry Meyers as the lead interrogator during the 7-hour detention at Fort Huachuca on September 9, 2025. Described as ~36 years old, brown hair, commander of force protection. Spelling of surname as heard by Harry; uncertain.

nodes.name: Blake Neff
nodes.description: Referenced by host as a potential relative (brother/cousin) of "Captain Nef" (N-518). Host speculates Blake Nef may have a military background despite public role as a producer of the Charlie Kirk show. Relationship unverified.

nodes.name: Tim Pool
nodes.description: Independent commentator featured in audio clip played on the show; subject of host's commentary criticizing his conduct toward her.

nodes.name: Arcadi Gaydamak
nodes.description: Russian-born, Israeli-French businessman identified in prior series episodes in connection with Angola Gate. Reported by host as recently sentenced in absentia for trafficking weapons. Allegedly living in Nashville under alias per seven viewer emails.

nodes.name: "Jonathan Schmidt"
nodes.description: Alleged alias used by Arcadi Gaydamak in Nashville, per seven tipster emails. Allegedly hired by Root Brands as a technology officer and claimed to be a billionaire.

nodes.name: Clay Thomas
nodes.description: Nashville businessman alleged by tipsters to have introduced Arcadi Gaydamak/"Jonathan Schmidt" to Root Brands. Host states she has reached out to Thomas.

nodes.name: Alex Smeirnoff
nodes.description: Ukrainian individual alleged by tipsters to be working with "Jonathan Schmidt"/Arcadi Gaydamak at Root Brands; characterized as a Ukrainian "fleeing the war."

nodes.name: Root Brands
nodes.description: Nashville-area company alleged by tipsters to employ "Jonathan Schmidt"/Arcadi Gaydamak as a technology officer. Host states she has reached out to Root Brands.

nodes.name: El Chapo (Joaquín Guzmán)
nodes.description: Named in 1990 tunnel narrative; photos on the Mexican side of the Sinaloa cartel tunnel allegedly showed a JTF-6 commander and U.S. Marine officers posing with him.

nodes.description: Persistent target: verifiable existence and contents of Fort Huachuca incident report 861-1-2025-MPC446 generated on September 9, 2025 in connection with Harry Meyers' detention.

nodes.name: 1990 Douglas, Arizona / Operation Catacomb Verification
nodes.description: Persistent target: verifiable history of Joint Task Force 6, Operation Catacomb, the Douglas–Agua Prieta tunnel discovery, and the alleged JTF-6 commander / El Chapo photographs. Connects to Harry Meyers' 35-year claim of retaliation and his NDA.

nodes.name: Brian Harpole Military Connection Verification
nodes.description: Persistent target: whether Brian Harpole has any military or government connection that could account for his presence at a JTF-SB command meeting at Fort Huachuca on September 9, 2025.

nodes.name: "Jonathan Schmidt" / Arcadi Gaydamak Identity Verification
nodes.description: Persistent target: whether the individual operating in Nashville under the name Jonathan Schmidt is in fact Arcadi Gaydamak, as alleged by seven viewers.

claims.label: Harry Meyers claims to have discovered the first Sinaloa cartel underground rail tunnel in 1990 while assigned to Joint Task Force 6 / Operation Catacomb
claims.claim: A then-20-year-old military sensor operator assigned to JTF-6 states he identified and helped raid the first discovered Sinaloa cartel underground rail tunnel between Douglas, Arizona and Agua Prieta in 1990.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check DEA, CBP, and Army historical records for the 1990 Douglas–Agua Prieta tunnel case; verify Harry's military service record and JTF-6 assignment.

claims.label: Photos on the Mexican side of the 1990 tunnel allegedly showed a JTF-6 commander posing with El Chapo and other U.S. officers
claims.claim: Harry states photos recovered from the Mexican side of the tunnel depicted the JTF-6 commander, El Chapo, El Chapo's architect Felipe, other U.S. Marine officers, and Mexican law enforcement personnel.
claims.investigative_direction: FOIA requests to DEA, CBP, and DOJ for case files associated with the 1990 tunnel seizure and any photographic evidence.

claims.label: Harry was placed under an NDA gag order dated 1990 to May 2025
claims.claim: An NDA gag order prevented Harry from publicly discussing the 1990 tunnel incident until May 2025.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain copy of the NDA via FOIA or congressional inquiry; verify dates and signatories.

claims.label: Harry received an army medal with writeups documenting his critical role in the 1990 mission
claims.claim: Harry states he received an army medal and writeups mentioning his critical role in the tunnel mission, even though his superiors took credit.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Harry's DD-214, military personnel file, and award writeups through appropriate channels.

claims.label: Harry checked into Candlewood Suites at Fort Huachuca on September 8, 2025 at approximately 5:37 PM
claims.claim: Harry Meyers arrived at Candlewood Suites on Fort Huachuca at approximately 5:37 PM on September 8, 2025, and observed a person he identified as special forces in the lobby.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull Candlewood Suites Fort Huachuca guest log for September 8, 2025 and corroborate with military visitor records.

claims.label: Harry entered a temporary JTF-SB headquarters on Fort Huachuca on September 9, 2025 at approximately 7:37 AM
claims.claim: Harry states he entered a temporary JTF-Southern Border headquarters at approximately 7:37 AM on September 9, 2025, immediately following the conclusion of a high-level meeting.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference base access logs and incident report 861-1-2025-MPC446.

claims.label: Harry observed approximately 12–13 lieutenant colonels / colonels at the JTF-SB meeting on September 9, 2025
claims.claim: Harry states approximately 12–13 E5/E6-grade officers (lieutenant colonels and colonels) were present in the meeting he walked into; host later confirms correction that the ranks are E5/E6 colonels and lieutenant colonels.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify through FOIA of incident report 861-1-2025-MPC446 and any meeting attendance logs.

claims.label: Harry identified Brian Harpole among those exiting the JTF-SB meeting on September 9, 2025
claims.claim: Harry states he identified Brian Harpole as one of the men exiting the JTF-SB meeting on September 9, 2025; Harry did not recognize him at the time and only identified him after Charlie Kirk's assassination made him publicly visible.
claims.investigative_direction: FOIA incident report 861-1-2025-MPC446 for visitor/attendee list; cross-reference with public schedule of Brian Harpole for September 9, 2025.

claims.label: A "Captain Nef" conducted a 7-hour interrogation of Harry at Fort Huachuca on September 9, 2025
claims.claim: After Harry entered the meeting room, two captains escorted him out and began a 7-hour interrogation accusing him of being a bomb threat, a spy, and a threat to himself or others. The interrogator Harry identifies as "Captain Nef" was approximately 36 years old with brown hair and was commander of force protection.
claims.investigative_direction: FOIA incident report 861-1-2025-MPC446; identify Captain Nef through Army CID and Fort Huachuca force protection roster.

claims.label: Incident report 861-1-2025-MPC446 was generated in connection with Harry's September 9, 2025 encounter at Fort Huachuca
claims.claim: An incident report numbered 861-1-2025-MPC446 was generated at Fort Huachuca on September 9, 2025 in connection with Harry's detention; Harry believes the report can be obtained via FOIA.
claims.investigative_direction: File FOIA request with the appropriate Army or DoD FOIA office for incident report 861-1-2025-MPC446.

claims.label: Arcadi Gaydamak was sentenced in absentia for trafficking weapons and is described as a former French intelligence agent
claims.claim: An article referenced on the show reports that Arcadi Gaydamak failed to appear for a court hearing and was sentenced in absentia for trafficking weapons; the article also identifies him as a French intelligence agent.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate and verify the article's primary source (court records, news outlet) to confirm sentencing details and intelligence affiliation.

claims.label: Arcadi Gaydamak was born in Russia and subsequently moved to Israel after Israeli statehood
claims.claim: Per the referenced article, Gaydamak was born in Russia and relocated to Israel after the establishment of the state.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify biographical details against public records and prior reporting on Gaydamak.

claims.label: Seven viewers emailed the show claiming Arcadi Gaydamak is living in Nashville under the name "Jonathan Schmidt"
claims.claim: Seven individuals, mostly men, emailed the show asserting that Arcadi Gaydamak is residing in Nashville using the alias Jonathan Schmidt and that he relocated there in June 2025.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain corroborating evidence via public records, business filings, immigration status checks, and law enforcement confirmation.

claims.label: "Jonathan Schmidt" is alleged to work at Root Brands as a technology officer and to have hired Ukrainians including Alex Smeirnoff
claims.claim: Tipsters claim that Jonathan Schmidt/Gaydamak was brought into Root Brands by Clay Thomas and has hired Ukrainian nationals, including Alex Smeirnoff, on the stated basis of fleeing the war.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain employment records, immigration paperwork (I-9, visa status), and confirm identities through public records and Root Brands communications.

claims.label: Tim Pool described Candace Owens as an "evil scumbag," "degenerate," and asserted she has no security
claims.claim: In an audio clip played on the show, Tim Pool calls Candace Owens an "evil scumbag" and a "degenerate," asserts she has no security, and dismisses her concerns about threats against her.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference Tim Pool's original broadcast to verify timestamp and context; host's response is rhetorical commentary rather than artifact-anchored.

claims.label: Tim Pool stated Candace Owens' residence has only a 4-foot wall and one security guard
claims.claim: In the audio clip, Tim Pool states that he visited Candace Owens' home, observed a 4-foot wall and one "fat guy" for security, and asserts that no one is "out for her."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Tim Pool's statement against the original broadcast and any public statements he has made about visiting the home.
